player_0.content: New plan: I failed to select the correct option because I misinterpreted the spatial relationships in the final paragraph. Specifically, I incorrectly assumed the order was Red-Brown-Yellow based on a flawed combination of clues, whereas the clues "Red is left of Brown" and "Yellow is right of Brown" actually confirm that Brown is in the middle. To avoid this, I will strictly map each clue to a specific position index (1, 2, or 3) rather than just relative order.
